hot.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
hot.summary: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 introduces a 38-billion-parameter multimodal autoregressive world model that unifies general image/video generation with embodied synthesis, preserving foundation model generalization while adapting to robot-centric multi-view reasoning and interaction. The system achieved superior multi-view consistency and instruction following compared to existing models, and augmented data generated by it improved real-world robot policy robustness by enhancing task completion progress in interference conditions from 36.9% to 63.2%.

hot.title: Bonsai 27B: Full 27B-Class Reasoning in Binary and Ternary Transformer Weights — On Laptops and Phones
hot.summary: PrismML introduces a post-training quantization technique that compresses a 27-billion parameter language model into binary (1.125 bpw) and ternary (1.71 bpw) formats, reducing its size to as little as 3.9 GB while preserving between 89.5% and 94.6% of its original intelligence on a comprehensive benchmark suite. This enables interactive inference on consumer laptops and high-end smartphones.

hot.title: ABot-3DWorld 0: A Universal World Model to Explore Any 3D Space
hot.summary: The AMAP CV Lab of Alibaba Group developed ABot-3DWorld 0, a universal multimodal 3D world model that converts diverse inputs (text, image, video) into explorable 3D Gaussian Splatting worlds. This system unifies input processing via a Spatial Generative Primitive and achieves enhanced 3D consistency and aesthetic quality, demonstrating improved fidelity compared to existing methods on various scene categories.

hot.title: Qwen-Music Technical Report
hot.summary: Qwen-Music presents a unified framework for controllable, high-fidelity song generation that separates semantic composition from acoustic rendering to produce complete vocal singing. The model achieves competitive subjective quality against leading systems like Suno V5.5 and ranks first in 13 out of 16 objective dimensions on bilingual text-to-music benchmarks.

hot.title: Quantum States Prepared by Wormholes: Long-Wavelength Deviations from Bunch-Davies
Proxy Exploration and Reusable Guidance: A Modular LLM Post-Training Paradigm via Proxy-Guided Update Signals
hot.summary: A modular post-training framework for large language models, Proxy-guided Update Signal Transfer (PUST), is presented, which separates policy exploration using a lightweight proxy model from the alignment of a more capable primary model. This approach extracts and calibrates relative improvement signals for efficient transfer, yielding up to a +30.2 average performance gain for Qwen3-8B in math and +4.6 in code over base models while significantly reducing computational overhead.

hot.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
hot.summary: A comprehensive survey from Yale University and UC Irvine provides the first organized overview of metacognition in large language models. The report clarifies foundational concepts, reviews current progress in measuring and implementing these abilities, and finds that while LLMs show basic metacognitive traits, significant limitations remain, necessitating further research into dedicated methods for enhancement.

Read It Back: Pretrained MLLMs Are Zero-Shot Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation
hot.summary: Researchers introduce SpectraReward, a training-free reward model for text-to-image generation that reuses frozen multimodal large language models' (MLLMs) image-text alignment capabilities. This approach consistently improves generation performance and enables Unified Multimodal Models to self-improve, with their intrinsic understanding branch matching or exceeding much larger external reward models.

LightMem-Ego: Your AI Memory for Everyday Life
hot.summary: LightMem-Ego introduces a lightweight, streaming multimodal memory system for personal AI assistants, continuously capturing and organizing a user's egocentric visual and audio experiences into a hierarchical memory. The system achieved 74.1% Recall@3 for memory retrieval and 55.6% human-judged QA accuracy across daily life scenarios, demonstrating its ability to answer questions about past events and routines with interactive latencies on mobile and wearable devices.

hot.title: Qwen-Audio-VAE Technical Report
hot.summary: Qwen-Audio-VAE, developed by the Qwen Team, introduces a continuous audio autoencoder that generates a compact 12.5 Hz latent representation while maintaining high-fidelity reconstruction across diverse audio domains. This model significantly accelerates encoding throughput by 3.62x, enabling more efficient and scalable training of downstream text-to-audio generative models.

hot.title: WanToFight: Real-Time Generative Game Engine for Multi-Player Combat Interaction
From World Action Models to Embodied Brains: A Roadmap for Open-World Physical Intelligence
hot.summary: Researchers propose a comprehensive co-evolution roadmap for open-world physical intelligence, aiming to address barriers in embodied AI by decoupling general physical reasoning from embodiment-specific execution through standardized interfaces and a closed-loop learning framework. This approach seeks to enable cumulative progress and the development of adaptive, self-improving agents capable of operating effectively in the physical world.

likes.title: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
likes.summary: The Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO) framework enhances asynchronous reinforcement learning for Large Language Models by stabilizing training and mitigating off-policy effects through single-trajectory processing and improved value model training. This approach leads to sustained performance gains and faster adaptation in complex agentic coding and reasoning tasks compared to synchronous baselines, achieving 97.3% accuracy on AIME2025.

likes.title: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Video Pretraining for Embodied Intelligence
likes.summary: LingBot-Video introduces an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) video foundation model tailored for embodied intelligence, enhancing physical coherence and instruction following in video generation. It integrates an MoE architecture for computational efficiency, a robot-augmented data corpus for physical grounding, and a multi-dimensional reward system for physically rational training. The model achieved an average score of 0.620 on the RBench benchmark and 40.4 on Physics-IQ Verified, outperforming other open-source models in generating physically plausible and task-oriented video content.

likes.title: Remember When It Matters: Proactive Memory Agent for Long-Horizon Agents
likes.summary: Researchers from Meta AI developed a proactive memory agent that runs alongside an action agent, selectively injecting concise, memory-grounded reminders into the action agent's context. This mechanism effectively addresses "behavioral state decay" and consistently improves success rates on complex, long-horizon tasks like command-line execution and conversational tool use.

likes.title: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
likes.summary: GenCeption, a generalist video perception model from Google DeepMind, repurposes a pre-trained text-to-video diffusion model into an efficient, feed-forward architecture. It achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance across diverse vision tasks like depth estimation, surface normal prediction, segmentation, and 3D keypoint estimation, exhibiting robust generalization from synthetic to real-world data and out-of-distribution categories.

likes.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
likes.summary: LingBot-VA 2.0 introduces a video-action foundation model specifically engineered for embodied robot control, utilizing a native causal architecture and a semantic visual-action tokenizer. This approach achieves a 14.0 percentage point improvement in average success rate on the RoboTwin benchmark and an end-to-end inference speedup of 6.5x, enabling real-time closed-loop control at up to 225 Hz asynchronous execution.

likes.title: Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions
likes.summary: LingBot-World-Infinity introduces an interactive world model capable of generating persistent, explorable virtual environments at 720p and 60 frames per second for over an hour without visual degradation. The system integrates a "Director-Pilot" agentic framework to support a versatile array of character actions and environmental interactions, advancing real-time interactive world simulation.

likes.title: Towards Mechanistically Understanding Why Memorized Knowledge Fails to Generalize in Large Language Model Finetuning
likes.summary: Researchers at HKUST identified that Large Language Models often fail to generalize memorized facts in reasoning tasks due to a "knowledge–circuit misalignment," where new information is stored but not effectively routed to the middle computational layers crucial for multi-step reasoning. A novel "self-patching" intervention revealed this dynamic, demonstrating that strategically re-routing these representations can recover 58-75% of the potential generalization performance.

likes.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
likes.summary: EmbodiedGen V2 presents a generative 3D world engine that produces "sim-ready" environments for embodied AI, uniquely integrating metric geometry, physical validity, and interaction semantics for direct use in policy learning. The system achieved a 96.5% human acceptance rate and 98.6% collision success for generated assets, and policies trained in these environments improved real-world task success from 21.7% to 75.0%.

Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
likes.summary: A framework for Visual Pretraining (VP) is introduced, enabling large foundation models to learn directly from raw visual scientific documents without explicit text extraction. This approach consistently improves performance on scientific reasoning and multimodal benchmarks, fostering better cross-modal alignment while utilizing more compact data representations compared to text-only pretraining.

likes.title: Sparse Delta Memory: Scaling the State of Linear RNNs through Sparsity
likes.summary: Researchers at Meta FAIR developed Sparse Delta Memory (SDM), an architecture for linear RNNs that uses sparsity to scale hidden state capacity by orders of magnitude while maintaining constant per-token compute. This method improves long-context recall and short-context performance, achieving lower training loss than dense baselines.

likes.title: AIDE²: The First Evidence of Recursive Self-Improvement
What LLM Forecasters Know but Don't Say: Probing Internal Representations for Calibration and Faithfulness
likes.summary: Internal representations of large language models provide a more accurate and calibrated confidence signal for forecasts than their verbalized outputs and can identify unfaithful reasoning in their Chain-of-Thought. This methodology further enables efficient question triaging by leveraging pre-reasoning forecast commitments, improving auditability and reducing inference costs.

likes.title: EgoWAM: World Action Models Beyond Pixels with In-the-Wild Egocentric Human Data
likes.summary: Researchers at the Georgia Institute of Technology developed EGOWAM, a framework for human-robot co-training that utilizes diverse egocentric human data by augmenting policies with an auxiliary world-model head to predict future scene states. This approach demonstrated that world models, particularly those based on DINO features or 3D motion flow, enable more robust transfer and out-of-distribution generalization compared to traditional behavior cloning, which often struggles with the embodiment gap.

likes.title: Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
likes.summary: Li Auto Inc.'s Mach-Mind-4-Flash model, a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with 3B activated parameters, attains performance comparable to or surpassing models in the 100B to 1T parameter range across diverse agentic tasks and reasoning benchmarks. This capability is achieved through an advanced post-training pipeline focused on reinforcement learning and distillation, rather than scaling pre-training compute.

likes.title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
likes.summary: An on-policy self-distillation framework, OPSD-V, is introduced to post-train few-step autoregressive video generators, leveraging real long-video data as privileged temporal context. This approach improves long-horizon video quality and motion dynamics for existing models, achieving quantitative gains on VBenchLong without increasing inference costs.

likes.title: TouchWorld: A Predictive and Reactive Tactile Foundation Model for Dexterous Manipulation
likes.summary: Researchers at Harbin Institute of Technology and PHANES AI developed TouchWorld, a hierarchical tactile foundation model for dexterous manipulation that separates semantic planning, tactile world-model prediction, and rapid tactile-conditioned refinement. This architecture consistently improved task success rates in real-robot manipulation, achieving an average of 65.0% in clean settings and 53.7% under human perturbations, by enabling both proactive anticipation and reactive adjustment of contact.
